hero.subtitle: Dandalin fasaha na gidaje da aka fi amincewa da shi a Najeriya — haɗa masu haya, masu gida, wakilai, da ƙwararrun shari'a a duk jihohi 36 da Babban Birnin Tarayya.

mission.heading: Sauya Yanayin Haya a Najeriya
mission.paragraph_1: A RentalHub NG, mun gaskata cewa kowa ya cancanci ƙwarewa mai aminci, bayyananne, da marar wahala lokacin neman gida. Manufarmu ita ce mu kawar da ƙulli, zamba, da takaici daga kasuwar haya ta Najeriya.
mission.paragraph_2: Ta hanyar haɗa fasaha tare da tsauraran tsarin tabbatarwa, tallafin shari'a, da ɗaukar ƙasa baki ɗaya, muna ƙarfafa masu haya su sami gidaje da aka tabbatar da kuma masu gida su haɗu da masu haya da suka cancanta — duka a cikin amintaccen tsarin duniya ɗaya.

journey.heading: Daga Hangen Nesa zuwa Gaskiya
journey.subtitle: Kowane babban dandali yana farawa da ra'ayi mai sauƙi. Ga labarin yadda RentalHub NG ya girma daga hangen nesa zuwa kasuwar gidaje da aka fi amincewa da ita a Najeriya.

team.heading: Haɗu da Tawagarmu
team.subtitle: Ƙwararrun masu himma da suka sadaukar da kai don sauya ƙwarewar gidaje ta Najeriya.

member_1.bio: Tare da fiye da shekaru 15 a cikin gidaje da fasaha, Zubair yana jagorantar RentalHub NG da hangen nesa na juyar da samun damar gidaje a Najeriya.

member_2.bio: Chioma tana kawo ƙwarewar gudanarwa daga bangaren sarrafa gidaje da daidaita ayyukan dabaru na manyan sikelin.

member_3.bio: Emeka shi ne wanda ya tsara dandalin RentalHub NG, yana kawo sabbin abubuwa a fasahar gidaje, tabbatar da dijital, da amintaccen ciniki.

member_4.bio: Ƙwararren ma'aikacin shari'a, Fatima tana tabbatar da cewa duk cinikin gidaje ya bi dokokin Najeriya kuma tana kare duk ɓangarorin da suka shiga.

testimonial_2.text: Sarrafa gidaje da yawa bai taɓa zama mai sauƙi haka ba. Allon aikin yana da sauƙin amfani kuma abokan cinikina suna son gabatarwar ƙwararru.

testimonial_3.text: Fasalin tallafin shari'a ya sauya komai. Na sami warware rigima cikin sauri ba tare da damuwar da aka saba ba.

faq_1.q: Wanene zai iya jera gidaje a RentalHub NG?
faq_1.a: Masu gida da aka tabbatar da wakilai masu rijista za su iya jera gidaje. Kuna buƙatar kammala tabbatar da ainihi kuma a amince muku kafin jeri.

faq_2.a: Muna ba da tsarin kyauta don jerin gida ɗaya na asali. Tsare-tsaren biya suna farawa daga N5,000 kowace jerin a shekara tare da ƙarin fasaloli da ganin.

faq_3.q: Ta yaya ake tabbatar da masu haya?
faq_3.a: Duk masu haya suna wucewa ta tabbatar da ainihi da ke da alaƙa da NIN kafin su iya nema ko tuntuɓar ku. Wannan yana tabbatar da cewa kuna hulɗa da mutane na gaskiya da aka tabbatar kawai.

faq_4.q: Zan iya jera gidaje a jihohi da yawa?
faq_4.a: E! RentalHub NG yana ɗaukar duk jihohi 36 + FCT. Kuna iya jera gidaje a ko'ina a Najeriya ba tare da la'akari da wurinku ba.

faq_5.a: Biyan kuɗin haya da ajiya ana gudanar da su kai tsaye tsakanin ku da mai haya. Dandalin yana sauƙaƙa aikace-aikace da sadarwa mai aminci.

faq_6.q: Idan na buƙaci taimako da jerina fa?
faq_6.a: Muna ba da tallafin imel da WhatsApp ga duk masu amfani. Masu tsarin Premium suna samun tallafin wakili na musamman don taimako na keɓe.

how_it_works.tenants_step_3_desc: Yi biyan kuɗi na lokaci ɗaya don buɗe cikakken bayanin gida, ciki har da bayanin tuntuɓar mai gida da kafofin watsa labarai na musamman.

how_it_works.landlords_step_1_desc: Ƙirƙiri asusun mai gida ko wakili kuma ka kammala tabbatar da bayanan kai don fara jera gidajenka.
how_it_works.landlords_step_2_desc: Ƙara gidanka tare da cikakken bayani, hotuna masu inganci, kuma ka saita sharuɗɗan hayarka.

how_it_works.landlords_step_4_desc: Duba aikace-aikace, yi hira da masu haya masu zuwa, kuma ka sarrafa duk gidajenka daga ɗaya allon aiki.

how_it_works.features_desc: Waɗannan fasaloli suna tabbatar da cewa kowane hulɗa a RentalHub NG yana da aminci da gaskiya.
how_it_works.features_verification_desc: Kowane mai amfani — mai haya, mai gida, da wakili — yana wucewa ta tabbatar da ainihi da ke da alaƙa da NIN don amintaccen tsarin duniya.

landlord_guide.hero_desc: Komai da kuke buƙatar sani game da jera, sarrafa, da ba da gidajenku haya cikin nasara a RentalHub NG — daga shirye-shirye zuwa shigar mai haya.
landlord_guide.started_desc: Bi waɗannan matakan don ƙirƙirar jerin da ke jawo masu haya masu inganci cikin sauri.
landlord_guide.prep_step_1_desc: Tattara duk takardu masu mahimmanci ciki har da shaidar mallaka, kuɗin wutar lantarki, rasit na harajin gida, da duk izinin gyare-gyare.
landlord_guide.prep_step_1_item_2: Kuɗin wutar lantarki na baya-bayan nan
landlord_guide.prep_step_2_desc: Tabbatar da cewa gidanka yana cikin yanayi mai kyau kafin jeri. Yi gyare-gyare da ake buƙata, share shi sosai, kuma ka yi la'akari da ɗaukar hoton ƙwararru.
landlord_guide.prep_step_2_item_2: Tsaftace duk ɗakuna da wuraren jama'a sosai
landlord_guide.prep_step_2_item_3: Yi la'akari da ɗaukar hoton ƙwararru
landlord_guide.prep_step_2_item_4: Shirya ɗakuna don su yi kama da faɗi da karɓuwa
landlord_guide.prep_step_3_desc: Kammala tabbatar da mai gidanka ta RentalHub NG. Wannan yana gina amincewa da masu haya masu zuwa kuma yana ƙara ganin jerin gidajenka.
landlord_guide.prep_step_3_item_4: Ƙara hoton bayanan kai da tarihin rayuwa
landlord_guide.prep_step_4_desc: Ƙirƙiri jerin mai jan hankali tare da cikakken bayani, hotuna masu inganci, da farashi mai gasa. Raba jerin gidajenka a duk dandamali.
landlord_guide.prep_step_4_item_4: Raba jerin a shafukan sada zumunta
landlord_guide.practices_heading: Nasihu Don Jerin Gidaje Masu Nasara
landlord_guide.practices_desc: Ƙwararrun dabaru don taimaka wa gidanka ya fito fili kuma ya jawo masu haya da suka dace.
landlord_guide.practice_1_title: Yi Amfani Da Sunaye Bayyanannu & Bayani Daidai
landlord_guide.practice_1_desc: Rubuta sunaye masu bayyanawa, na gaskiya waɗanda ke nuna mahimman fasaloli.
landlord_guide.practice_1_tip_1: Ambaci adadin ɗakuna da matakin bene
landlord_guide.practice_1_tip_2: Haɗa kusancin sufuri da abubuwan more rayuwa
landlord_guide.practice_1_tip_3: Ka bayyana takamaiman abubuwan da ke cikin kuɗin
landlord_guide.practice_2_desc: Hotuna masu haske, da aka ɗauka da kyau daga kusurwoyi da yawa suna ƙara yawan tambayoyi sosai.
landlord_guide.practice_2_tip_1: Ɗauki a lokacin rana tare da kyakkyawan haske
landlord_guide.practice_2_tip_2: Ɗauka duk ɗakuna ciki har da kicin da ɗakunan wanka
landlord_guide.practice_3_desc: Yi bincike kan gidaje masu kamanceceniya a yankinka kafin saita farashi.
landlord_guide.practice_3_tip_1: Bincika jerin gidaje 5+ masu kama da juna a yankinka
landlord_guide.practice_3_tip_2: Yi la'akari da yanayin gida da abubuwan more rayuwa
landlord_guide.practice_3_tip_3: Yi la'akari da bambancin buƙatun yanayi
landlord_guide.practice_4_desc: Masu haya suna son amsa cikin sauri. Yi ƙoƙarin amsawa cikin sa'o'i 24.
landlord_guide.practice_4_tip_1: Kunna sanarwar tura don sabbin saƙonni
landlord_guide.practice_4_tip_2: Saita amsa ta atomatik ga tambayoyin gama-gari
landlord_guide.practice_5_title: Ka Rike Jerin Gidajenka A Sabo
landlord_guide.practice_5_desc: Cire jerin gidaje da zarar an ba da haya, sabunta matsayin samuwa nan take.
landlord_guide.practice_5_tip_1: Sabunta matsayi nan da nan bayan hayar
landlord_guide.practice_6_desc: Nuna matsayinka na tabbatarwa, fasalolin tsaro, da duk takaddun amincin da kake da su.
landlord_guide.protips_desc: Haɓaka ƙwarewar mai gidanka da waɗannan fahimtar masana.
landlord_guide.protip_1_title: Ra'ayi Na Farko Yana Da Muhimmanci
landlord_guide.protip_1_desc: Hoto na farko a jerin gidanka shine mafi muhimmanci. Zaɓi hoton haske mai kyau na ƙwararru.
landlord_guide.protip_2_desc: Yi amfani da kayan aikin tabbatarwa na RentalHub NG don tabbatar da ainihin masu haya kafin karɓar aikace-aikace.
landlord_guide.protip_3_title: Yi Amfani Da Kwangiloli Masu Aminci
landlord_guide.protip_3_desc: Koyaushe yi amfani da yarjejeniyoyin haya da aka bita a shari'a. RentalHub NG yana ba da damar samun samfuran shari'a.
landlord_guide.protip_4_desc: Yi amfani da allon aikin mai gidanka don bibiyi kallo, tambayoyi, da ƙimar aikace-aikace.
landlord_guide.protip_5_desc: Sadarwa ta ƙwararru, mai saurin amsawa tana kaiwa ga kyawawan kima da shawarwari.
landlord_guide.protip_6_desc: San wa kanka da dokokin hayar Najeriya a jiharka.
landlord_guide.mistakes_heading: Kuskure Na Yau Da Kullun Don Gujewa
landlord_guide.mistakes_desc: Guji waɗannan ramukan don tabbatar da ƙwarewar jera gidaje mai sauƙi kuma mai nasara.
landlord_guide.mistake_1_desc: Hotuna masu duhu, marasa haske, ko kaɗan suna kore masu haya masu zuwa.
landlord_guide.mistake_1_fix: Ɗauki mai ɗaukar hoto na ƙwararru ko yi amfani da hasken rana na halitta da kyamarar wayar salula mai inganci.
landlord_guide.mistake_2_desc: Rashin cikakkun bayanai game da kayan aiki, filin ajiye mota, ko dokokin gida yana kaiwa ga ƙananan aikace-aikace.
landlord_guide.mistake_2_fix: Cika duk filayen gida gaba ɗaya.
landlord_guide.mistake_3_desc: Saita haya sama da ƙimar kasuwa yana kaiwa ga tsawon zaman babu kowa.
landlord_guide.mistake_3_fix: Bincika jerin gidaje masu kamanceceniya a yankinka kuma ka saita farashi mai gasa.
landlord_guide.mistake_4_desc: Amsa a makara yana fusata masu haya kuma ya sa ka bayyana a matsayin mara ƙwararru.
landlord_guide.mistake_4_fix: Saita sanarwa kuma yi ƙoƙarin amsa duk tambayoyi cikin sa'o'i 24.
landlord_guide.faq_desc: Komai da kuke buƙatar sani game da jeri a RentalHub NG.
landlord_guide.cta_desc: Shiga fiye da masu gida 5,000 masu nasara a RentalHub NG. Jera gidanka yau kuma ka fara haɗuwa da masu haya da aka tabbatar, masu cancanta a duk faɗin Najeriya.
